sections.title: Welcome to Real Numbers and Their Properties
learning_goals: Engage viewers and introduce the topic of real numbers.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Standard introductory section with avatar-only presentation.

sections.title: What You'll Learn: Real Numbers and Factorization
learning_goals: Understand the definition and classification of real numbers.
Grasp the Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic and its applications.
Learn how to perform prime factorization.
Master calculating HCF and LCM using prime factorization.
Discover how to prove the irrationality of numbers.
Solve word problems involving HCF and LCM.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Overview of learning objectives presented with bullet points and avatar.

sections.title: Defining and Classifying Real Numbers
learning_goals: Define real numbers and understand their properties.
Distinguish between rational and irrational numbers.
Classify numbers into natural, whole, integers, rational, and irrational sets.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Visual representation of number sets, number line, and p/q form for classification is best done with Manim.

sections.title: The Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic
learning_goals: State and explain the Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic.
Understand the concept of unique prime factorization for composite numbers.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Illustrating prime factorization and uniqueness with animated examples is ideal for Manim.

sections.title: Mastering Prime Factorization
learning_goals: Perform prime factorization for any composite number using the division method.
Identify prime factors of a given number.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Step-by-step animated demonstration of the prime factorization process is well-suited for Manim.

sections.title: Calculating HCF and LCM with FTA
learning_goals: Calculate the HCF (Highest Common Factor) of two or more numbers using prime factorization.
Calculate the LCM (Lowest Common Multiple) of two or more numbers using prime factorization.
Understand the relationship between HCF, LCM, and the product of two numbers.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Animated examples showing the steps to find HCF and LCM using prime factors will enhance understanding.

sections.title: Proving Irrationality by Contradiction
learning_goals: Understand the method of proof by contradiction.
Apply proof by contradiction to demonstrate the irrationality of numbers like √2.
sections.renderer_reasoning: The logical steps and mathematical notation involved in a proof by contradiction are best presented with Manim for clarity.

sections.title: HCF and LCM in Word Problems
learning_goals: Apply HCF and LCM concepts to solve real-world word problems.
Identify whether a problem requires HCF or LCM for its solution.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Animated step-by-step solutions to word problems will help visualize the application of HCF and LCM.

sections.title: Test Your Knowledge: Real Numbers
learning_goals: Assess understanding of real number classification.
Practice applying the Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic.
Solve problems related to HCF, LCM, and irrationality proofs.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Interactive flashcard-style quiz questions are presented without complex animations.

sections.title: Key Takeaways: Real Numbers
learning_goals: Reinforce key definitions and concepts of real numbers.
Recall the steps for prime factorization, HCF, LCM, and irrationality proofs.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Flashcard-style review of main concepts and definitions.
